mapper.select: SELECT r.recorded_case_id FROM fgc.validation_run vr, LATERAL fgc.record_exception_detection( CONCAT('DATA_QUALITY:', TO_CHAR(vr.validation_month, 'YYYY-MM'), ':INSURANCE_CONTRACT:', #{contractId}, ':DATA_QUALITY'), 'DATA_QUALITY', 'DATA_QUALITY', 'WARNING', #{validationRunId}, #{contractId}, NULL::bigint, NULL::bigint, 'INSURANCE_CONTRACT', CAST(#{contractId} AS varchar), #{title}, #{description}, '{}'::jsonb ) r WHERE vr.validation_run_id = #{validationRunId}

SELECT r.recorded_case_id FROM fgc.validation_run vr, LATERAL fgc.record_exception_detection( CONCAT('DATA_QUALITY:', TO_CHAR(vr.validation_month, 'YYYY-MM'), ':INSURANCE_CONTRACT:', #{contractId}, ':', #{paymentStage}), 'DATA_QUALITY', 'DATA_QUALITY', 'WARNING', #{validationRunId}, #{contractId}, NULL::bigint, NULL::bigint, 'INSURANCE_CONTRACT', CAST(#{contractId} AS varchar), CONCAT('1,200% 한도 검증 실패 - ', #{paymentStage}), #{description}, '{}'::jsonb ) r WHERE vr.validation_run_id = #{validationRunId}

SELECT r.recorded_case_id FROM fgc.validation_run vr, LATERAL fgc.record_exception_detection( CONCAT('ARBITRAGE_CANDIDATE:', TO_CHAR(vr.validation_month, 'YYYY-MM'), ':CONTRACT:', #{contractId}, ':', #{paymentStage}), 'ARBITRAGE_CANDIDATE', 'ARBITRAGE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED', 'HIGH', #{validationRunId}, #{contractId}, NULL::bigint, NULL::bigint, 'ARBITRAGE_CHECK', CAST(#{arbitrageCheckId} AS varchar), '차익거래 검토대상', #{description}, '{}'::jsonb ) r WHERE vr.validation_run_id = #{validationRunId}

SELECT r.recorded_case_id FROM fgc.validation_run vr, LATERAL fgc.record_exception_detection( CONCAT(#{exceptionType}, ':', TO_CHAR(vr.validation_month, 'YYYY-MM'), ':CONTRACT:', #{contractId}, ':', #{paymentStage}), #{exceptionType}, #{exceptionType}, 'WARNING', #{validationRunId}, #{contractId}, NULL::bigint, NULL::bigint, 'ARBITRAGE_CHECK', CAST(#{arbitrageCheckId} AS varchar), #{title}, #{description}, '{}'::jsonb ) r WHERE vr.validation_run_id = #{validationRunId}

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.new_case) FROM fgc.cap_check cc JOIN fgc.validation_run vr ON vr.validation_run_id = cc.validation_run_id LEFT JOIN fgc.cap_rule_set crs ON crs.cap_rule_set_id = cc.cap_rule_set_id, LATERAL fgc.record_exception_detection( CONCAT( CASE cc.result_status WHEN 'VIOLATION' THEN 'CAP_VIOLATION' WHEN 'REVIEW_REQUIRED' THEN 'CAP_REVIEW_REQUIRED' END, ':', TO_CHAR(vr.validation_month, 'YYYY-MM'), ':CONTRACT:', cc.contract_id, ':', cc.payment_stage, ':', cc.cap_rule_set_id ), CASE cc.result_status WHEN 'VIOLATION' THEN 'CAP_VIOLATION' WHEN 'REVIEW_REQUIRED' THEN 'CAP_REVIEW_REQUIRED' END, CASE cc.result_status WHEN 'VIOLATION' THEN 'CAP_LIMIT_VIOLATION' WHEN 'REVIEW_REQUIRED' THEN 'CAP_CALCULATION_REVIEW_REQUIRED' END, CASE cc.result_status WHEN 'VIOLATION' THEN 'CRITICAL' WHEN 'REVIEW_REQUIRED' THEN 'WARNING' END, cc.validation_run_id, cc.contract_id, NULL::bigint, crs.policy_version_id, 'CAP_CHECK', CAST(cc.cap_check_id AS varchar), CASE cc.result_status WHEN 'VIOLATION' THEN '1,200% 한도 초과' WHEN 'REVIEW_REQUIRED' THEN '1,200% 한도 검토 필요' END, CONCAT( '지급단계=', cc.payment_stage, ', 한도액=', cc.limit_amount, ', 산입액=', cc.included_amount, ', 사용률=', COALESCE(CAST(cc.usage_pct AS varchar), '-') ), '{}'::jsonb ) r WHERE cc.validation_run_id = #{validationRunId} AND cc.result_status IN ('VIOLATION', 'REVIEW_REQUIRED')

WITH classified AS ( SELECT ac.arbitrage_check_id, ac.validation_run_id, ac.contract_id, ac.payment_stage, ac.result_status, ac.calculation_snapshot, ac.net_difference_amount, vr.validation_month, CASE WHEN ac.result_status = 'CANDIDATE' THEN 'ARBITRAGE_CANDIDATE' WHEN COALESCE(ac.calculation_snapshot ->> 'decisionReason', '') LIKE '%환급률표 후보가 없습니다%' OR COALESCE(ac.calculation_snapshot ->> 'decisionReason', '') LIKE '%환급률표 ID가 없습니다%' THEN 'REFUND_TABLE_MISSING' WHEN COALESCE(ac.calculation_snapshot ->> 'decisionReason', '') LIKE '%상품코드%' OR COALESCE(ac.calculation_snapshot ->> 'decisionReason', '') LIKE '%환급률표가 일치하지 않습니다%' THEN 'PRODUCT_CODE_MISMATCH' WHEN COALESCE(ac.calculation_snapshot ->> 'decisionReason', '') LIKE '%여러 건%' THEN 'POLICY_DUPLICATE' ELSE 'DATA_QUALITY' END AS computed_type FROM fgc.arbitrage_check ac JOIN fgc.validation_run vr ON vr.validation_run_id = ac.validation_run_id WHERE ac.validation_run_id = #{validationRunId} AND ac.result_status IN ('CANDIDATE', 'REVIEW_REQUIRED') ) SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.new_case) FROM classified c, LATERAL fgc.record_exception_detection( CONCAT(c.computed_type, ':', TO_CHAR(c.validation_month, 'YYYY-MM'), ':CONTRACT:', c.contract_id, ':', c.payment_stage, CASE WHEN c.computed_type <> 'ARBITRAGE_CANDIDATE' THEN CONCAT(':', c.computed_type) ELSE '' END), c.computed_type, CASE WHEN c.computed_type = 'ARBITRAGE_CANDIDATE' THEN 'ARBITRAGE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED' ELSE c.computed_type END, CASE c.result_status WHEN 'CANDIDATE' THEN 'HIGH' WHEN 'REVIEW_REQUIRED' THEN 'WARNING' END, c.validation_run_id, c.contract_id, NULL::bigint, NULL::bigint, 'ARBITRAGE_CHECK', CAST(c.arbitrage_check_id AS varchar), CASE c.result_status WHEN 'CANDIDATE' THEN '차익거래 검토대상' WHEN 'REVIEW_REQUIRED' THEN '차익거래 검증 자료 확인 필요' END, COALESCE( c.calculation_snapshot ->> 'decisionReason', CONCAT('지급단계=', c.payment_stage, ', 순차액=', c.net_difference_amount) ), '{}'::jsonb ) r

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.new_case) FROM fgc.reconciliation_result rr INNER JOIN fgc.reconciliation_run rrn ON rrn.reconciliation_run_id = rr.reconciliation_run_id INNER JOIN fgc.validation_run vr ON vr.validation_run_id = rrn.validation_run_id, LATERAL fgc.record_exception_detection( CONCAT( 'RECONCILIATION_MISMATCH:', TO_CHAR(vr.validation_month, 'YYYY-MM'), ':CONTRACT:', rr.contract_id, ':', rrn.payment_stage, ':', LEFT(rr.match_group_key, 140), ':', MD5(rr.match_group_key), ':', COALESCE(rr.primary_reason_code, rr.result_type, 'RECONCILIATION_MISMATCH') ), 'RECONCILIATION_MISMATCH', COALESCE(rr.primary_reason_code, rr.result_type, 'RECONCILIATION_MISMATCH'), CASE rr.result_type WHEN 'REVIEW_REQUIRED' THEN 'WARNING' ELSE 'HIGH' END, rrn.validation_run_id, rr.contract_id, COALESCE(rr.actual_agent_id, rr.expected_agent_id), rrn.tolerance_policy_version_id, 'RECONCILIATION_RESULT', CAST(rr.reconciliation_result_id AS varchar), '대사 불일치', CONCAT( '지급단계=', rrn.payment_stage, ', 결과유형=', rr.result_type, ', 예상금액=', rr.expected_total_amount, ', 실제금액=', rr.actual_total_amount, ', 차액=', rr.difference_amount, ', 주원인=', COALESCE(rr.primary_reason_code, '-') ), '{}'::jsonb ) r WHERE rrn.validation_run_id = #{validationRunId} AND rr.result_type <> 'MATCHED'

WITH candidates AS ( SELECT rr.reconciliation_result_id, rr.contract_id, rr.result_type, rr.expected_total_amount, rr.actual_total_amount, rr.difference_amount, rr.primary_reason_code, rr.actual_agent_id, rr.expected_agent_id, rr.match_group_key, rrn.validation_run_id, rrn.payment_stage, rrn.tolerance_policy_version_id, vr.validation_month FROM fgc.reconciliation_result rr INNER JOIN fgc.reconciliation_run rrn ON rrn.reconciliation_run_id = rr.reconciliation_run_id INNER JOIN fgc.validation_run vr ON vr.validation_run_id = rrn.validation_run_id WHERE rr.reconciliation_run_id = #{reconciliationRunId} AND rr.result_type <> 'MATCHED' ) SELECT COUNT(*) AS candidateCount, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.new_case) AS createdCount FROM candidates c, LATERAL fgc.record_exception_detection( CONCAT( 'RECONCILIATION_MISMATCH:', TO_CHAR(c.validation_month, 'YYYY-MM'), ':CONTRACT:', c.contract_id, ':', c.payment_stage, ':', LEFT(c.match_group_key, 140), ':', MD5(c.match_group_key), ':', COALESCE(c.primary_reason_code, c.result_type, 'RECONCILIATION_MISMATCH') ), 'RECONCILIATION_MISMATCH', COALESCE(c.primary_reason_code, c.result_type, 'RECONCILIATION_MISMATCH'), CASE c.result_type WHEN 'REVIEW_REQUIRED' THEN 'WARNING' ELSE 'HIGH' END, c.validation_run_id, c.contract_id, COALESCE(c.actual_agent_id, c.expected_agent_id), c.tolerance_policy_version_id, 'RECONCILIATION_RESULT', CAST(c.reconciliation_result_id AS varchar), '대사 불일치', CONCAT( '지급단계=', c.payment_stage, ', 결과유형=', c.result_type, ', 예상금액=', c.expected_total_amount, ', 실제금액=', c.actual_total_amount, ', 차액=', c.difference_amount, ', 주원인=', COALESCE(c.primary_reason_code, '-') ), '{}'::jsonb ) r

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.new_case) FROM fgc.vw_journal_imbalance vw INNER JOIN fgc.journal_header h ON h.journal_header_id = vw.journal_header_id INNER JOIN fgc.validation_run vr ON vr.validation_run_id = h.validation_run_id, LATERAL fgc.record_exception_detection( CONCAT( 'JOURNAL_IMBALANCE:', TO_CHAR(vr.validation_month, 'YYYY-MM'), ':CONTRACT:', COALESCE(CAST(h.contract_id AS varchar), '-'), ':', h.journal_type, ':', h.source_entity_type ), 'JOURNAL_IMBALANCE', 'JOURNAL_IMBALANCE', 'CRITICAL', h.validation_run_id, h.contract_id, NULL::bigint, NULL::bigint, 'JOURNAL_HEADER', CAST(vw.journal_header_id AS varchar), '검증원장 차변·대변 불균형', CONCAT( '분개번호=', vw.journal_no, ', 차변합계=', vw.debit_total, ', 대변합계=', vw.credit_total, ', 차액=', vw.difference_amount ), '{}'::jsonb ) r WHERE h.validation_run_id = #{validationRunId}
